title: Extract the normalized completed diagonal arrow from the limit specification
statement: For a prime ell, a scheme Y, and a proof that ell is a unit in its global sections, fix the derived-category localizations of the integral, constant, sequence and completed coefficient categories on the diagonal surface. Let D be the derived diagonal reduction. If its full finite and completed limit specification of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit] holds, there is a completed diagonal arrow delta satisfying the full normalized characterization IsDiagonalLimit of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-limit-characterization]. No field, finite-type or noetherian assumption is required for this logical extraction.

source.place: Proof (3), supplying the normalized completed arrow from diagonal-limit clause 3 before applying the rational projective-line triangle theorem.

proof.text: Eliminate the five outer existential witnesses in DiagonalCompletedLimitSpec. Its last clause supplies the derived-limit data, quotient comparison, normalized source and target isomorphisms, and DiagonalArrowCompatibility. The latter contains a unique completed arrow satisfying the limit equation. Apply ExistsUnique.exists, retain the finite-cycle normalization and all completed compatibility data, and reorder the existential witnesses to obtain an arrow followed by IsDiagonalLimit. Prove this rearrangement for arbitrary abelian categories and exact restriction functors, then specialize with the original specification arguments, including its cached instance proofs. The Lean kernel checks the resulting application. The category instances are explicit, so no unused field, geometry or localization-record assumptions are introduced.

theorem completedLimit_exists
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalCompleted ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (data : DiagonalCompletedLimitSpec ℓ Y hY D) :
    ∃ δ : diagonalCompletedDomain ℓ Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain ℓ Y,
      DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit ℓ Y hY D δ
